authority: media provenance for reviewed practical guides
scope_note: Every media asset used by a reviewed practical guide must be declared here. Original diagrams are preferred; externally derived media require a source URL, access date, and reuse basis.

assets.reuse_basis: Original SVG regenerated from the repository's nine hash-bound Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 Silicon SCF outputs; no external figure or pseudopotential payload was copied.
assets.caption: Actual 3 x 3 QE 7.5 Silicon total-energy series at 30/40/50 Ry and 6-cubed/8-cubed/10-cubed meshes, relative to the 50 Ry, 10-cubed row. The charge-density cutoff stays fixed at eight times the wavefunction cutoff, so this is not independent ecutrho convergence or target-observable acceptance.
assets.alt: Plot of nine actual Silicon Quantum ESPRESSO total energies versus 30, 40, and 50 Ry wavefunction cutoff, with separate curves for 6, 8, and 10 cubed k meshes and a stated 50 Ry 10 cubed reference.

assets.reuse_basis: Original SVG regenerated from the repository's nine hash-bound Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 Silicon SCF outputs; no external figure or pseudopotential payload was copied.
assets.caption: Actual QE 7.5 Silicon total energies over 6-cubed/8-cubed/10-cubed meshes at three wavefunction cutoffs, relative to the 50 Ry, 10-cubed row. Occupations are fixed; this is not metallic k-mesh-by-smearing evidence, full-zone target convergence, or a transferable mesh.
assets.alt: Plot of nine actual Silicon Quantum ESPRESSO total energies versus 6, 8, and 10 cubed k meshes, with separate curves for 30, 40, and 50 Ry cutoffs and a stated 50 Ry 10 cubed reference.

assets.reuse_basis: Original SVG rendered by this repository from its committed QE 7.5 bands.x text output and hash-bound SeeK-path ledger; the raw unintended U-K connector remains preserved but is not drawn as a valid SeeK-path segment.
assets.caption: Eight Kohn-Sham branches along the declared Gamma-X-U | K-Gamma-L-W-X route. The visible U | K break omits 19 interior points from an unintended connector in the preserved raw sequential input.
assets.alt: Labelled Silicon band plot with Gamma, X, U, K, Gamma, L, W, and X ticks, a visible U to K route break, and eight blue branches.

assets.reuse_basis: Original plot generated from all 14 rows of the GPL-3.0-or-later CoSb3 condtens member at commit 7ed9146c42d671562daee86d87e253fcbdedaeab; no source or publisher figure was copied.
assets.caption: Published CoSb3 diagonal conductivity per relaxation time and Seebeck output versus temperature, redrawn from a hash-bound BoltzTraP2 archive member without rerunning the calculations.
assets.alt: Two-panel plot of published CoSb3 conductivity divided by relaxation time and Seebeck coefficient from 100 to 750 kelvin, with a Seebeck sign-change bracket between 200 and 250 kelvin.

assets.reuse_basis: Original SVG generated by this repository from its hash-bound QE 7.5 fixed-cell BFGS Silicon output; no external figure or potential file was copied.
assets.caption: Maximum absolute free Cartesian force component and the separately reported QE aggregate Total force across five ionic evaluations; the final component gate passes only for this fixed-cell teaching run.
assets.alt: Log-scale force plot showing maximum absolute free Cartesian components and separate aggregate Total force values for five actual Silicon QE ionic evaluations, with a declared component threshold.

assets.reuse_basis: Original comparison generated by this repository from the same frozen OQMD snapshot; OQMD data are reused under CC BY 4.0 and one declared entry is withheld only for sensitivity analysis.
assets.caption: With the LiP competitor present, Li₄P₃ lies above the LiP–Li₃P₇ tie line; withholding that one entry promotes the unchanged Li₄P₃ point onto the reduced-set hull.
assets.alt: Side-by-side Li-P convex hulls showing Li4P3 above the complete-set hull and on the reduced-set hull after one LiP competitor is withheld.

assets.reuse_basis: Original SVG generated by this repository from its retained Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 total-DOS data; no external plot or synthetic DOS curve was used.

assets.alt: Silicon total density of states from retained Quantum ESPRESSO output, with energy relative to the recorded Fermi reference and states per electronvolt per cell.

assets.reuse_basis: Original SVG generated by this repository from its retained Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 Gamma-point ph.x output; no external phonon plot or invented mode was used.

assets.alt: Bar plot of six retained Silicon Gamma-point phonon frequencies from Quantum ESPRESSO, separated into three near-zero acoustic diagnostics and three optical modes.
